limitations_and_boundaries: The study uses in vitro NPC cultures, which may not fully recapitulate in vivo conditions.
No statistical methods were used to predetermine sample size; experiments were not randomized and investigators were not blinded.
The theoretical model is linearized and assumes specific forms of Q-tensors; it provides qualitative but not quantitative agreement.
Cell tracking at high density becomes challenging due to cell accumulation, limiting accuracy.
The study focuses on 2D cultures; 3D mound formation is noted but not fully characterized.
